title: Group anagrams into a deterministic order
prompt:
Write groupAnagrams(String[] words) returning a List<List<String>> (not a Map, not an
array) grouping the words that are anagrams of one another. Two words are anagrams when
they use exactly the same letters the same number of times.

The output must be fully deterministic:
  - inside each group, the words are sorted lexicographically ascending;
  - the groups themselves are sorted by their first word, ascending.
Duplicate words are kept, so they appear as repeats inside their group. Comparison is
case sensitive, and an empty input returns an empty list.

Example:
  groupAnagrams(["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"])
    -> [["ate", "eat", "tea"], ["bat"], ["nat", "tan"]]

Keep the class name Solution and the given method signature.
